notes.title: Small update 1.2 (02.14.2022)
notes.notes:
Switching the language now does not to restart the game.
Small adjustments for easy interaction in the game menu.
Small fixs on the game location.

notes.title: Update 1.1 (01.29.2022)
notes.notes:
Added static candles that cannot be extinguished, but with which you can light your candle.
Minor adjustments have been made to the operation of the inventory.
Now an item that is not assembled will show its name.
Fixed cases of incorrect rendering of the text in the initial monologue.
Fixed other minor bugs.
